title: Proverbs Chapter 28 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 28 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 28 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 28.

questions.question: What do the wicked do when no man pursueth?
questions.explanation: The wicked flee when no man pursueth, as stated in Proverbs 28:1.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 28, who is bold as a lion?
questions.explanation: The righteous are described as bold as a lion in Proverbs 28:1.

questions.question: What is said about a poor man that oppresseth the poor?
options: He is like a sweeping rain
questions.correctAnswer: He is like a sweeping rain
questions.explanation: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is compared to a sweeping rain in Proverbs 28:3.

questions.question: What happens to those who forsake the law?
questions.explanation: Those who forsake the law are said to praise the wicked in Proverbs 28:4.

questions.question: True or False: Evil men understand judgment.
questions.explanation: Evil men understand not judgment, as stated in Proverbs 28:5.

questions.question: Who is better according to Proverbs 28:6?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:6 states that better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness.

questions.question: What is said about a wise son in Proverbs 28:7?
options: He is a companion of riotous men
questions.explanation: A wise son is one who keepeth the law, according to Proverbs 28:7.

questions.question: True or False: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:17 states that a man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit.

questions.question: What happens to those who turn away their ear from hearing the law?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:9 states that even his prayer shall be abomination if he turns away from hearing the law.

questions.question: What will happen to the upright according to Proverbs 28:10?
options: They will fall into the pit
They will have good things in possession
questions.correctAnswer: They will have good things in possession
questions.explanation: The upright shall have good things in possession, as stated in Proverbs 28:10.

questions.question: True or False: The prince that wanteth understanding is a great oppressor.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:16 states that the prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor.

questions.question: What will happen to a man that walketh uprightly according to Proverbs 28:18?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:18 states that whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved.

questions.question: Which comes first in Proverbs 28?
options: The wicked flee when no man pursueth
Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness
They that forsake the law praise the wicked
questions.correctAnswer: The wicked flee when no man pursueth
questions.explanation: The first statement in Proverbs 28 is that the wicked flee when no man pursueth, found in Proverbs 28:1.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:25 say about a proud heart?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:25 states that he that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife.

questions.question: True or False: He that hideth his eyes from the poor shall not lack.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:27 states that he that giveth unto the poor shall not lack; hiding one's eyes leads to curses.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 28 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 28 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 28:11, who is wise?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:11 states that 'the rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.' This shows that true wisdom is not dependent on wealth but on understanding.

questions.question: What happens when the wicked rise, according to Proverbs 28:12?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:12 indicates that 'when the wicked rise, a man is hidden,' highlighting the fear and concealment that often accompanies wickedness.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 28:14 states that a man who hardens his heart will find happiness.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:14 says, 'but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief,' indicating that hardening one's heart leads to trouble, not happiness.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 28:15, how is a wicked ruler described?
options: As a roaring lion and a ranging bear
questions.correctAnswer: As a roaring lion and a ranging bear
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:15 compares a wicked ruler to 'a roaring lion, and a ranging bear,' emphasizing the danger and oppression they pose to the poor.

questions.question: What do Proverbs 28:19 and 28:20 imply about work and wealth?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:19 states that 'he that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread,' while 28:20 promises that 'a faithful man shall abound with blessings.' Together, they teach the value of hard work and faithfulness.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 28:25 teaches that a proud heart can lead to strife.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:25 states, 'He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife,' confirming that pride often leads to conflict and discord.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:13 say about covering sins?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:13 indicates that 'He that covereth his sins shall not prosper,' meaning that hiding wrongdoing leads to negative consequences.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 28:18 relate to walking uprightly?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:18 states, 'Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved,' showing that living a righteous life is connected to salvation.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:9 say about the prayers of those who ignore the law?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:9 states, 'even his prayer shall be abomination,' indicating that ignoring God’s law renders one’s prayers unacceptable.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 28:16, what characterizes a prince who lacks understanding?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:16 indicates that 'the prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor,' suggesting that a lack of wisdom leads to oppression.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:22 warn about those who hasten to be rich?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:22 states that 'he that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him,' warning against the dangers of greed.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 28:10 connect to the fate of the upright?
options: They will fall into a pit
They will have good things in possession
questions.correctAnswer: They will have good things in possession
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:10 states that 'the upright shall have good things in possession,' linking the fate of the upright to positive outcomes.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 28:27 says that giving to the poor leads to lack.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:27 states, 'He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack,' indicating that generosity towards the poor actually leads to abundance.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 28 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 28.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:1 say about the wicked and the righteous?
options: The wicked are bold as a lion.
The righteous flee when no man pursueth.
The wicked flee when no man pursueth.
questions.correctAnswer: The wicked flee when no man pursueth.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:1 states that 'The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.', indicating that the wicked live in fear, while the righteous stand firm.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 28:6, who is better off?
options: The rich man who is perverse.
The poor man walking in uprightness.
The man who oppresses the poor.
questions.correctAnswer: The poor man walking in uprightness.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:6 says, 'Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.', highlighting the value of integrity over wealth.

questions.question: What is said about a man who covers his sins in Proverbs 28:13?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:13 states, 'He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.', affirming the importance of confession.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:20 say about a faithful man?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:20 indicates that 'A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.', linking faithfulness to divine favor.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 28:22, what is the mindset of a man who hasteth to be rich?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:22 states, 'He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.', warning against greed and impatience.

questions.question: What literary device is used in Proverbs 28:25, contrasting the proud and the trustful?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:25 employs parallelism by contrasting 'He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife' with 'but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.', highlighting two opposing paths.

questions.question: What occurs when the wicked rise according to Proverbs 28:28?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:28 mentions that 'When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.', illustrating the fear that accompanies wickedness.

questions.question: He that trusteth in his own heart is described as what in Proverbs 28:26?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:26 states, 'He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.', warning against self-reliance.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 28:10 indicates that causing the righteous to go astray will result in the one who causes the transgression falling into a pit.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:10 states, 'Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit...', affirming the truth of this statement.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 28:4 teaches that those who keep the law praise the wicked.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:4 states, 'They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.', making this statement false.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:27 say about giving to the poor?
options: He that giveth unto the poor shall be poor.
He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack.
He that giveth unto the poor shall be cursed.
He that giveth unto the poor shall be punished.
questions.correctAnswer: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:27 declares, 'He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.', emphasizing the blessings of generosity.

questions.question: Which New Testament principle is echoed in Proverbs 28:13 regarding confession and mercy?
options: Romans 8:28 about all things working together.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:13's principle of confessing and forsaking sins for mercy is echoed in James 5:16, which encourages believers to confess their sins to one another for healing.

questions.question: What theme from Proverbs 28:21 about respect of persons connects to the New Testament?
options: We should all have respect of persons.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:21 warns against respect of persons, which connects to James 2:1 that admonishes believers not to show favoritism, emphasizing equality.

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 28 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 28 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:1 teach about the disposition of the wicked versus the righteous?
options: The wicked are bold as lions
The wicked flee when no man pursueth
questions.correctAnswer: The wicked flee when no man pursueth
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:1 contrasts the wicked and the righteous, stating that the wicked flee without cause, whereas the righteous exhibit boldness like a lion.

questions.question: In Proverbs 28:3, what analogy is used to describe a poor man who oppresses the poor?
questions.explanation: The verse compares a poor man who oppresses others to a sweeping rain that leaves no food, signifying destruction and lack of provision.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 28:4, what is the relationship between forsaking the law and praising the wicked?
options: Forsaking the law leads to ruin
Forsaking the law praises the righteous
Forsaking the law praises the wicked
questions.correctAnswer: Forsaking the law praises the wicked
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:4 indicates that those who forsake the law end up praising the wicked, suggesting a moral decline in society.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:6 suggest about the condition of a poor man who walks in uprightness?
options: He is more blessed than the rich
questions.correctAnswer: He is more blessed than the rich
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:6 asserts that a poor man who maintains uprightness is better off than a rich man who is perverse, highlighting the value of integrity over wealth.

questions.question: Which concept is highlighted in Proverbs 28:10 regarding the fate of those who lead the righteous astray?
options: They shall fall into their own pit
They will be punished by others
questions.correctAnswer: They shall fall into their own pit
questions.explanation: The verse warns that those who lead the righteous astray will ultimately face their own downfall, reinforcing the principle of reaping what one sows.

questions.question: Proverbs 28:12 discusses the relationship between righteous men rejoicing and the wicked rising. What does it imply?
options: There is great glory when the wicked rise
questions.explanation: When righteous men rejoice, it brings glory; conversely, when the wicked rise, it causes the righteous to conceal themselves, suggesting a societal decline.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:13 state about those who cover their sins?
questions.explanation: The verse clearly states that concealing one's sins leads to a lack of prosperity, while confessing and forsaking them results in mercy.

questions.question: In Proverbs 28:16, what is said about a prince who lacks understanding?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:16 indicates that a prince lacking understanding becomes an oppressor, emphasizing the importance of wisdom in leadership.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:19 teach about the consequences of tilling one's land?
options: It results in plenty of bread
questions.correctAnswer: It results in plenty of bread
questions.explanation: The verse teaches that diligent work in tilling one's land will yield an abundant harvest, contrasting it with the pursuit of vain persons that leads to poverty.

questions.question: What is the implication of Proverbs 28:25 regarding a proud heart?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:25 asserts that a proud heart causes conflict, while trust in the Lord leads to abundance, highlighting the dangers of pride.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 28:20, what is said about a faithful man?
questions.explanation: The verse promises that a faithful man will experience an abundance of blessings, reinforcing the value of faithfulness in life.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:27 reveal about generosity towards the poor?
options: It ensures one will not lack
questions.correctAnswer: It ensures one will not lack
questions.explanation: The verse teaches that generosity towards the poor will be rewarded, indicating that those who give will have their needs met.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Proverbs 28:2 and 28:5 convey about leadership and understanding?
options: Understanding is not necessary for leadership
Understanding and knowledge prolong the state
Many princes will lead to prosperity
questions.correctAnswer: Understanding and knowledge prolong the state
questions.explanation: Both verses emphasize that wise leadership, grounded in understanding and knowledge, is crucial for sustaining a society.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 28:14 teach about the man who fears God?
options: He is happy and avoids mischief
questions.correctAnswer: He is happy and avoids mischief
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:14 indicates that a man who fears the Lord is happy, while hardening one's heart leads to trouble, highlighting the protective nature of reverence for God.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that wealth is a sign of God's favor. What does Proverbs 28:22-23 actually teach?
options: Hastening to be rich leads to poverty
questions.correctAnswer: Hastening to be rich leads to poverty
questions.explanation: Proverbs 28:22 warns that those who rush to gain wealth without integrity will ultimately face poverty, countering the notion that wealth equates to divine approval.
